tasks.goal: Correct duplicate-application confirmation hierarchy and token-aware submission behavior.
input_facts: Backend submission accepts unchanged conflicts when the token matches
CREATE_NEW conflict resolution currently returns the same report
The current frontend reopens the dialog for every HTTP 409
invariants: Cancel-old, edit-old and defer behavior remain
No unrelated dirty-worktree change is overwritten
interface_contracts: CANCEL_OLD and EDIT_OLD choose events carry the historical application
Only a changed server token can invalidate current confirmation
non_goals: No API, backend, database, permission, dependency or mobile-specific change
action_bounds: Modify only the dialog event/template and page pending/submit conflict branches
Use existing Element Plus buttons and release API functions
Do not refactor unrelated release-page logic
acceptance_checks: Footer order and primary style match R1
Dialog closes before token-bearing submit completes
Repeated clicks cannot create overlapping confirms
evidence_required: Desktop browser path and console/network result
Governance and scope-check results with unrelated baseline failures disclosed
tasks.rollback: Restore only the modified sections of the two Vue files from the T1 pre-change snapshot.
stop_conditions: A backend or API contract change becomes necessary
A user or process changes either target file during implementation
The local runtime cannot produce a duplicate conflict after three setup attempts
escalation_conditions: Confirmation must persist across page reloads
A new public error-code contract is required

sampling_plan.label: Final convergence sample
sampling_plan.trigger: T1 verified and regression checks complete
